text:
maria: Quick heads-up — prod release v1.3.2 blocked. cosign verification failed for image redwood-registry/prod/service:1.3.2. CI indicates SBOM mismatch in the signature step. Anyone seen this?

deploy-bot: Release #142 | status: blocked | step: image-signature-check
ci-bot: Pipeline: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/98234
ci-bot: Log excerpt:
```
verifying signatures...
error: no matching signature found for digest sha256:abcd1234
sbom mismatch: expected SBOM sha256:fff... got: 000...
``` 
tony: ugh. saw a similar diff yesterday after that buildpack bump — layer tar ordering changed. non-deterministic builds = different digest -> cosign fails.
priya: is the builder image pinned in the build job? if not, a new builder could've caused this.
dave: correct, our pack CLI version changed in the builder image two days ago. that can reorder layers.
maria: options: 1) promote previous image (1.3.1) and unblock release, 2) re-run build with pinned builder / reproducible flag and then re-sign, 3) temporarily allow unsigned images in pipeline (needs PM/security ok).
tony: quick mitigation = promote 1.3.1. safe, minimal risk. then fix build process and create a hotfix for reproducible builds.
priya: PM (anna) pinged — she's OK with promoting previous image for the change window. Security wants sign-off but ok for emergency.
dave: to reproduce locally:
```
pack build --builder v1.12.3 --publish --env BP_REPRODUCIBLE=true
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/ci/cosign-key redwood-registry/prod/service:1.3.2
cosign verify redwood-registry/prod/service:1.3.2
```
maria: I'll promote 1.3.1 now and trigger pipeline. tagging release notes accordingly.
ci-bot: Promotion job started: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/promote-561
deploy-bot: Release #142 | action: promoted image -> redwood-registry/prod/service:1.3.1 | status: unblocked
maria: thanks all. I'll open a follow-up ticket to pin builder and add reproducible-build checks to CI. :white_check_mark:
